capabilities: Build interactive image maps with markers, routes, zones, portals and fog of war
Show notes, images and maps on a separate player window
Track initiative, hit points, temporary HP and conditions
Create and edit D&D 5e statblock notes with a form editor
Link conditions, creatures and spells inside notes
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. Interface available in English and Spanish. Some features rely on internal Obsidian APIs, guarded so the plugin keeps working without them. No network or telemetry. Bundles the Leaflet library and includes SRD 5.2 material under CC-BY-4.0.
problem: Running a tabletop game from Obsidian leaves no way to show maps, notes and live combat state to the players at the table.
summary: Tabletop RPG game-master toolkit with interactive image maps, a second-screen player window, an initiative tracker and D&D 5e statblocks.
